{{Top}}
A '''mineralogist''' was a [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] who specialized in the study of the various [[Mineral/Legends|minerals]] in the [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]] [[Vegath Tist]] claimed to be a mineralogist in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] to join the crew of the ''[[FarStar]]''.
